label: managerial or leadership office in
definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or institution Y, such as chairperson, head, director, president, manager, chief or executive.
scope_notes: Preserves prior organizational office family. The dictionary combines qualifying offices; founder, owner, analyst, ordinary employment or sporting lead alone is insufficient. Historical offices qualify.
